sources.title: Skånetrafiken, Malmö C terminal map (June 2026)
sources.note: Supplied by the owner; used to place exits, stairs and lifts, not copied.

Jernhusen's station map of Malmö C (January 2026 PDF): shop units, names and outlines from the PDF's own vector shapes, placed by fitting them to OpenStreetMap's shop pins (median 4.7 m off). Not ODbL: Jernhusen hasn't licensed the plan; see data/stations/README.md.
Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000003).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract): City Tunnel platforms from their layer, 4 hand connections for platform heads 3 for the west exit and 4 lifts at the middle and east exits, placed from Skånetrafiken's terminal map (June 2026) supplied by the owner.
Shops, cafés, restaurants and services from Jernhusen's January 2026 station map, with their outlines (31 places); Oak berry and Gottelisa, no longer on it, removed.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 34 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000003).
